content.text: Proposed package path under rest/pagination; waiting on review of the null sentinel choice.
List and search routes each implement their own cursor encoding, which has drifted on null handling and sort-key escaping.
Extract shared helpers for encoding and decoding opaque cursors and route both families through them.
Add golden fixtures for multi-field sort keys so pagination stays stable across releases.

description_text:
List and search routes each implement their own cursor encoding, which has drifted on null handling and sort-key escaping.

Add golden fixtures for multi-field sort keys so pagination stays stable across releases.
